jobs.title: Advocacy Advisor, Domestic Policy
jobs.reason: The role requires significant prior employment and advocacy experience with the US Congress and Executive Branch, which the candidate lacks. While the candidate possesses strong research, data analysis, and policy writing skills, the specific US domestic policy focus and high seniority level make this a poor fit.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Domestic
jobs.reason: While the candidate possesses strong research, data analysis, policy writing, and communication skills highly relevant to the role, and the mission aligns with their interests in justice and policy, the seniority requirements are a significant mismatch. The Program Manager title, high salary range, and responsibilities like "manages complex projects" suggest a need for substantial full-time professional experience (likely 5+ years) that the candidate, with their assistant-level experience, does not yet have.

jobs.title: Advocacy Advisor, Foreign Policy
jobs.reason: This role is far too senior for the candidate, requiring extensive prior foreign policy leadership experience, experience managing teams/large projects, and direct engagement with senior U.S. policymakers or prior employment in U.S. government agencies. While the candidate's academic field and research skills show promise, they lack the specific U.S. foreign policy expertise and the many years of professional advocacy experience demanded.

jobs.title: Advocacy Advisor, Foreign Policy
jobs.reason: The role is a senior-level position requiring extensive foreign policy leadership experience, including prior US government employment and managing large projects, which the candidate does not possess. While the candidate's academic background and research skills align well with the field, they lack the specific advocacy and high-level relationship management experience required for this senior role.

jobs.title: Employment Specialist – Connect to Work Isle of Wight
jobs.reason: The candidate's background is heavily academic, focused on international relations, law, and higher education policy research, which is a significant mismatch for an employment specialist role. While the candidate possesses strong research and analytical skills, these are not directly transferable to the client-facing, employment support nature of this position. The role likely requires specific experience in employment services or social work, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Candidate Legal Practitioner (AD.09.4)
jobs.reason: While the candidate's academic interests in international law, genocide studies, and human rights align perfectly with CALS's mission, and their research, writing, and data analysis skills are excellent, the role explicitly requires an LLB or BProc degree. The candidate does not possess this fundamental qualification for a "Candidate Legal Practitioner" position, making the role unsuitable despite other strengths.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.reason: This role is a poor fit as it requires substantial experience in B2B sales and account management, which the candidate lacks. While the candidate has strong academic credentials and some research skills, these do not align with the commercial, target-driven nature of a Senior Account Manager position. The only minor alignment is the "interest in global risk" and the candidate's multilingual skills.

jobs.title: LECTURER.2.01 - Academic Advisor at Lecturer level (AC08) (AC.08.4)
jobs.reason: The candidate demonstrates strong alignment in the field of higher education policy and possesses most of the required skills, including research, data analysis, and policy writing. However, the role explicitly requires at least two years of experience as an academic advisor in the South African public higher education sector at a Lecturer level, which the candidate, with only student assistant experience, does not meet.
jobs.type: Full-time position (subject to standard probation requirements)

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This role is entirely unsuitable for the candidate. It requires an admitted practising legal practitioner with at least ten years of post-admission experience and an LLM, none of which the candidate possesses. While the candidate has strong academic credentials and research skills, they lack the fundamental legal qualifications, practical experience, and seniority required for a Director of a Law Clinic.

jobs.title: Sustainable Finance & Portfolio Solutions Lead
jobs.reason: This role is a poor fit due to a significant mismatch in field and seniority. The "Sustainable Finance & Portfolio Solutions Lead" position requires deep expertise in finance and sustainability consulting, which does not align with the candidate's academic focus on international relations, law, and social sciences. Furthermore, the "Lead" title indicates a senior role requiring extensive professional experience, which the candidate, currently pursuing an MSc with student assistant experience, does not possess.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
jobs.reason: The candidate's strong research, data analysis (Python, SPSS), and policy writing skills align well with the role's tasks, and their interest in policy and power networks connects to the project. However, the position explicitly requires a PhD or equivalent, which the candidate, currently pursuing an MSc, does not possess. This fundamental seniority mismatch makes the candidate ineligible despite some relevant field interests and strong functional skills.

jobs.title: JUSTICE Internship
jobs.reason: The candidate's strong academic background in International Relations, International Law, and Genocide Studies, coupled with their research and policy writing experience, aligns well with the human rights and justice aspects of the role. The internship level is also perfectly suited to their experience. However, the job explicitly requires a UK qualifying law degree or equivalent, which the candidate does not possess, making them ineligible despite strong transferable skills.
jobs.type: Internship (three months, full-time or part-time minimum three days per week)

jobs.title: Legal Fellow (sponsored by Linklaters LLP)
jobs.reason: While the candidate's academic focus on international law, human rights, and policy research aligns well with the fellowship's scope, and their research and analytical skills are strong, they do not meet the essential eligibility criteria of having completed a UK qualifying law degree, GDL, SQE Part 1, or CILEX CPQ Advanced Stage. This is a fundamental requirement that the candidate does not possess.
jobs.type: Full-time (six months), flexible part-time options available
